knownGaps.why: DEFECT, not a limitation, and the same one recorded on digitalocean-pricing and github-sponsors: the four-significant-figure cap is applied per amount rather than to the page grid, so a price crossing a power of ten renders one decimal shorter than the column it sits in. This page is the capture that proved the configurator fix: its option rows are <label>s around radios, and they used to leave "48GB - $2,000.00" in dollars beside options already in ZEC.
